d.ko: Roll for initiative, take attacks of opportunity, manage player location and the verticality of the battle field in this Turn-Based Tactical RPG based on the SRD 5.1 Ruleset. In Solasta, you make the choices, dice decide your destiny.
d.en: Roll for initiative, take attacks of opportunity, manage player location and the verticality of the battle field in this Turn-Based Tactical RPG based on the SRD 5.1 Ruleset. In Solasta, you make the choices, dice decide your destiny.
d.zh: 《Solasta》是一款基于龙与地下城 SRD 5.1 版本规则手册的回合制战术角色扮演游戏。掷骰检定先攻，抓住进攻机会，组织好角色位置和战场的垂直平面。选择由你，命运由骰。传奇冒险即将开启。
